projects.title: NexoneZ Time - Attendance System
projects.tagline: Check-in, QR scanning, leave and reports for staff, interns and students.
projects.description: A mobile-first attendance platform. Employees and interns check in and out (button or rotating office QR code), request leave and see their month. Admins manage people and batches, mark class attendance for students, approve leave and export CSV reports. All times follow Pakistan time.
highlights: QR check-in with a code that rotates every 60 seconds
Optional location and office-network checks
Student class attendance per batch and day
Leave approval, monthly reports and CSV export
JWT login, rate limiting, role-based admin access

projects.title: Health Ways - Pharmacy Management System
projects.tagline: Batch-level stock traceability, FEFO point of sale and supplier tracking.
projects.description: A hospital pharmacy system designed around full traceability. Every delivery becomes its own batch with supplier, price, quantity and expiry, and sales automatically use the earliest-expiry batch first (FEFO). Includes point of sale, supplier credit tracking, returns, expiry and low-stock alerts, user roles and analytics.
highlights: Batch and lot traceability from purchase to sale
FEFO point of sale
Supplier balances, purchase orders and goods received notes
Expiry tracker and low-stock alerts
Role-based access and reports

projects.title: Nexone Clinic - Clinic Management and EHR
projects.tagline: Reception, doctor, lab, pharmacy and billing in one role-based system.
projects.description: A clinic management and EHR product with a marketing landing page, a role-based application and a real-time backend. Staff get dedicated desks (reception, doctor, lab, pharmacy, cashier) plus an admin portal with dashboard metrics and patient records.
highlights: Role-based desks: admin, reception, doctor, lab, pharmacy, counter
Real-time updates with Socket.IO
Patient registration, records and billing
Landing page built for early go-to-market

projects.title: NexoneZ Software House Website
projects.tagline: Company website with a 3D hero, services, portfolio and workflow sections.
projects.description: Marketing website for NexoneZ Software House, presenting services, industries, workflow and portfolio with a dark gradient design and a 3D-style hero.
highlights: Responsive multi-section layout
Services, industries, workflow and portfolio sections

projects.title: HA Enterprises - Business Accounts (Khata) App
projects.tagline: Customers, suppliers, ledger, invoices, stock and profit in one place.
projects.description: An accounting app for a local business: parties and ledgers, invoices, purchases, payments, stock, expenses, profit and loss, backups and data import.
highlights: Party ledger with date filters and corrections
Invoices, payments, purchases and stock
Profit and loss and supplier reports
Backups and CSV import

projects.title: Al Madina Laboratory - LIMS
projects.tagline: Patients, test types, blood tests and final lab reports.
projects.description: A laboratory information management system: patient records, configurable test types, blood tests and printable reports with charts.
highlights: Patient and test-type management
Blood test entry and final reports
Charts for report data

projects.title: SpeakEase - Gesture and Emotion Communication App
projects.tagline: Android app that turns gestures and emotion context into English and Urdu speech.
projects.description: A final-year-project style Android prototype built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. A pipeline converts recognised gestures plus emotion context (neutral, urgent, confused) into sentences, spoken offline in English and Urdu. Includes sentence history, settings and a Gesture Guide.
highlights: Offline-first with on-device text-to-speech
Bilingual output: English and Urdu
MediaPipe and TensorFlow Lite integration points
